children: Freedom Capital Markets maintained their Buy rating on Ecovyst's stock with a price target of $15.00.
The price target implies an upside of 42.3% from the Sep 15 close of $10.54.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Ecovyst benefits from a favorable contract pricing structure for sulfuric acid, with approximately 90% of its sales secured through formula-based supply contracts, ensuring stable revenue even amidst tight global sulfur markets.

: The completion of the Calabrian acquisition and the ramp-up of the Waggaman sulfuric acid unit are expected to significantly boost earnings in the second half of the fiscal year, leading to upgraded EPS estimates and reinforcing investor confidence.
